answer.says: You are right, Shri. I mistake the person for the office. The procedure is the thing itself; I shall wait for it to move, as one waits for a season to turn. And I will take the raita.
answer.thought: He is right to correct me. I have treated the bureaucracy as a subject to be argued with, when it is a mechanism to be endured. The state is not the man who signs the paper, but the system that makes the paper necessary. I will eat and let the day close.
